name: IITL Nimbus The Hyde Park
description: IITL Nimbus The Hyde Park is a highly secure, completed residential development in Sector 78, Noida, featuring biometric/RFID access systems and beautiful themed gardens.
long_description: IITL Nimbus The Hyde Park is a premier, ready-to-move-in residential complex situated in the prime core of Sector 78, Noida. Spanning over 15 sprawling acres, this highly secure community houses 2,092 units across 10 towers rising G+21 and G+25 levels. Developed via a robust joint venture between IITL Projects Ltd and the Nimbus Group, the project stands out for structural execution and seamless, delay-free handovers. The development is equipped with smart infrastructure systems, including automated RFID vehicular entry, biometric secure lobbies, high-speed OTIS elevators, and premium plumbing fixtures from Roca. Residents enjoy extensive amenities, including a massive central clubhouse with an infinity pool and themed manicured lawns, all while being situated a mere 300 meters from the Sector 50 Aqua Line Metro Station.
tagline: The Crown Jewel of Lifestyle and Connectivity
address: Plot No. GH-03, Sector 78, Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201304

investmentReport.appreciation_desc: Estimated capital appreciation based on infra growth

analysis_intelligence.decision_thesis: IITL Nimbus The Hyde Park represents an exceptionally safe, transit-oriented ready-to-move buy, boasting direct 300m walking proximity to the Sector 50 Metro Station.
why_buy: Peerless Metro Connectivity: Just 300m from the Aqua Line platform, making commuting stress-free.
Advanced Security Systems: RFID vehicular barriers and biometric towers prevent illegal common-area entry.
Flawless Legal Status: Fully delivered with 100% active registries and zero title blocks.
why_avoid: High Dense Complex: Over 2,000 units spread across the complex results in a high-density, lively feel.
Moderate Premium Pricing: Proximity to the metro station has priced-in major capital values.

competitors.name: Mahagun Moderne
competitors.this_project_advantage: Closer to the Sector 50 Metro Station (300m vs 500m); lower average unit pricing standard.
competitors.competitor_advantage: Moderne Verona offers more upscale architecture (Hafeez Contractor) and larger layout profiles.
competitors.verdict: Choose Nimbus for daily transit ease and entry-level value; choose Mahagun for architectural prestige and larger multi-generation homes.
competitors.price_delta_note: Nimbus is approx. Rs 500/sqft cheaper than Mahagun Moderne.
